words.enDefinition: the counter where shoppers can get help in a store

examples.en: The sign directed customers with online purchases to the customer service desk upstairs.
examples.zh: 牌子指引线上购物的顾客到楼上的「客服柜台」。

examples.en: I showed the receipt at the customer service desk before explaining the problem.
examples.zh: 我在「客服柜台」出示收据，然后说明了问题。

collocations: go to the customer service desk
ask at the customer service desk

words.enDefinition: the group that helps customers with questions or problems

examples.en: The customer support team had already spoken to the shop about my order.
examples.zh: 「客服团队」就我的订单已经和门店沟通过了。

examples.en: I called the customer support team when the package arrived without its power cord.
examples.zh: 包裹送到了，却没配电源线，我便打电话给「客服团队」。

collocations: speak to the customer support team
a member of the customer support team

words.enDefinition: an employee who helps shoppers and works in a store

examples.en: A store associate helped me find the printed order information on the receipt.
examples.zh: 一名「门店店员」帮我找到了收据上印着的订单信息。

examples.en: The store associate asked whether I had ordered through the app or website.
examples.zh: 「门店店员」问我是在应用里还是在网站上下单的。

words.enDefinition: the manager responsible for staff and activity on a sales floor

examples.en: The clerk asked the floor manager to take a look at my order.
examples.zh: 店员请「卖场主管」帮忙看一下我的订单。

examples.en: I spoke to the floor manager near the entrance after comparing the boxes.
examples.zh: 我对照过两个盒子后，在入口附近和「卖场主管」谈了谈。

words.enDefinition: a section of a site containing answers and ways to get assistance

examples.en: I searched the help center before sending a message about the missing cable.
examples.zh: 我先在「帮助中心」搜索了一下，再发消息说电线少了一根。

examples.en: The help center had an article about orders delivered in more than one box.
examples.zh: 「帮助中心」有篇文章，讲订单分多个箱子送达的情况。

words.enDefinition: a category of instructions or answers on a support page

examples.en: I selected a help topic about damaged items to see my contact options.
examples.zh: 我选了有关商品损坏的「帮助主题」，查看能通过哪些方式联系。

examples.en: That help topic explained where to find my messages from the seller.
examples.zh: 那个「帮助主题」说明了在哪里能找到卖家发给我的消息。

collocations: a help topic about online orders

words.enDefinition: an online form for sending a message to an organization

examples.en: I used the contact form because I could attach the two photos there.
examples.zh: 我用了「联系表单」，因为可以在那里附上两张照片。

examples.en: The contact form asked which store I had bought the lamp from.
examples.zh: 「联系表单」问我那盏台灯是在哪家店买的。

words.enDefinition: the email address used for requests for help

examples.en: I found the support email address at the bottom of my order confirmation.
examples.zh: 我在订单确认邮件的底部找到了「客服邮箱地址」。

examples.en: The store gave me a different support email address for online purchases.
examples.zh: 门店给了我另一个「客服邮箱地址」，处理线上购物问题。

collocations: write to the support email address

words.enDefinition: a telephone number for getting a company's help with purchases

examples.en: The customer service number was printed below the opening hours on the receipt.
examples.zh: 「客服电话」印在收据上的营业时间下方。

examples.en: I tried the customer service number while the shop was still open.
examples.zh: 店还开着的时候，我试着拨了「客服电话」。

collocations: look up the customer service number

words.enDefinition: the times when people can reach a support team

examples.en: I checked the support hours before trying to reach someone after my seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课结束后，我先查了「客服在线时间」，再试着联系。

examples.en: The support hours on the website differed from the hours on my receipt.
examples.zh: 网站上的「客服在线时间」和我的收据上写的不一样。

words.enDefinition: assistance provided over the phone

examples.en: I chose telephone support because it was easier to explain the two separate orders.
examples.zh: 我选择了「电话客服」，因为两个独立订单用电话更好说清楚。

examples.en: The store offers telephone support for both in-store and online purchases.
examples.zh: 在门店和网上买的商品，这家店都提供「电话客服」。

words.enDefinition: assistance provided through email messages

examples.en: I picked email support because I had several photos to send with my query.
examples.zh: 我选择了「邮件客服」，因为咨询时要一起发送好几张照片。

examples.en: Email support asked me which part of the desk had not arrived.
examples.zh: 「邮件客服」问我书桌的哪部分没收到。

words.enDefinition: an online exchange with a staff member in real time

examples.en: I used live chat to ask about a parcel during my lunch break.
examples.zh: 我趁午休用「在线人工聊天」问了一下包裹的情况。

examples.en: The website offered live chat after I chose a topic on the help page.
examples.zh: 我在帮助页面选好主题后，网站提供了「在线人工聊天」。

collocations: speak to someone through live chat

words.enDefinition: a small interactive box that opens a chat on a website

examples.en: I opened the chat widget in the corner of the order page.
examples.zh: 我打开了订单页面角落里的「网页聊天窗口」。

examples.en: The chat widget disappeared when I made the browser window too narrow.
examples.zh: 浏览器窗口缩得太窄时，「网页聊天窗口」就不见了。

words.enDefinition: the waiting line for customers trying to reach a chat agent

examples.en: The chat queue had grown by the time I found my order email.
examples.zh: 我找到订单邮件时，「在线客服等候队列」已经更长了。

examples.en: My screen still showed the chat queue after I added details about the order.
examples.zh: 我添上订单详情后，屏幕上还是显示「在线客服等候队列」。

words.enDefinition: your place in a line waiting to be served

examples.en: I checked my queue position after the page said several people were ahead.
examples.zh: 页面说前面还有几个人后，我看了自己的「排队顺位」。

examples.en: The chat window stopped showing my queue position when an agent became available.
examples.zh: 有客服可以接入时，聊天窗口就不再显示我的「排队顺位」。

words.enDefinition: music played to a caller who is temporarily waiting

examples.en: The hold music stopped just before a different adviser answered my call.
examples.zh: 另一位客服接起我的电话之前，「电话等候音乐」停了。

examples.en: I heard hold music after the adviser asked me to wait for a minute.
examples.zh: 客服请我稍等片刻，之后我就听到了「电话等候音乐」。

collocations: put a caller on hold with hold music

words.enDefinition: a feature that lets callers request a return call

examples.en: I selected the callback option so I could put my phone down.
examples.zh: 我选了「客服回拨选项」，这样就可以先把手机放下。

examples.en: The recording mentioned a callback option after telling me how many callers were waiting.
examples.zh: 录音告诉我有多少人等候后，提到了「客服回拨选项」。

words.enDefinition: the period when a return call is expected

examples.en: I chose a callback window after the last lecture on my timetable.
examples.zh: 我选了课表上最后一节课结束后的「预计回拨时段」。

examples.en: The callback window on the screen was later than I had expected.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的「预计回拨时段」比我想的要晚。

words.enDefinition: a message sent without a person writing it at the time

examples.en: The automated reply said my photos had been added to the request.
examples.zh: 「自动回复」说，我的照片已经添加到申请里了。

examples.en: I received an automated reply before anyone at the shop read my message.
examples.zh: 店里还没人看我的消息，我就收到了「自动回复」。

words.enDefinition: to talk to a real person instead of an automated system

examples.en: I chose to speak to a human after the menu repeated itself.
examples.zh: 语音菜单开始重复后，我选了「找人工客服」。

examples.en: “Can I speak to a human?” I typed when the bot misunderstood my question.
examples.zh: 机器人误解了我的问题，我打字问「能转人工客服吗？」

collocations: ask to speak to a human
choose to speak to a human
wait to speak to a human

words.enDefinition: a real staff member available through a support channel

examples.en: A live agent joined the chat after I gave the order number.
examples.zh: 我提供订单号后，一名「人工客服」接入了聊天。

examples.en: The pop-up said no live agent was available until the following morning.
examples.zh: 弹窗提示，要到第二天早上才有「人工客服」。

collocations: a live agent joins the chat

words.enDefinition: a period of activity in a support chat from opening to ending

examples.en: The chat session ended before I could upload the second photo of the box.
examples.zh: 我还没上传箱子的第二张照片，「这次客服对话」就结束了。

examples.en: I started a new chat session after my laptop went to sleep.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑休眠后，我重新开始了「一次客服对话」。

words.enDefinition: a written copy of messages sent during an online chat

examples.en: The shop emailed a chat transcript after the adviser ended our conversation.
examples.zh: 客服结束对话后，店家发来了一份「聊天文字记录」。

examples.en: I downloaded the chat transcript so I could check exactly what the adviser said.
examples.zh: 我下载了「聊天文字记录」，方便核对客服说的原话。

collocations: keep a copy of the chat transcript

words.enDefinition: an inbox where support messages are collected or displayed

examples.en: The reply appeared in my support inbox rather than in my email.
examples.zh: 回复出现在我的「客服收件箱」里，电子邮箱里没有。

examples.en: I opened the support inbox to read the seller's response on the platform.
examples.zh: 我打开平台上的「客服收件箱」，查看卖家的回复。

collocations: a message in the support inbox

words.enDefinition: a website area where customers can handle tasks without staff help

examples.en: I checked the self-service portal first to see whether my case had changed.
examples.zh: 我先到「自助服务入口」查看工单有没有变化。

examples.en: The self-service portal let me attach a photo without starting a new chat.
examples.zh: 在「自助服务入口」，我可以附上照片，不用重新开启聊天。

collocations: sign in to the self-service portal

words.enDefinition: to get in touch with the person or shop that sold something

examples.en: The order page told me where to contact the seller about the wrong colour.
examples.zh: 订单页面告诉我在哪里「联系卖家」，反映颜色发错了。

examples.en: I tried to contact the seller before asking the marketplace for help.
examples.zh: 我先试着「联系卖家」，然后才找电商平台帮忙。

collocations: contact the seller through the platform
contact the seller about an order

words.enDefinition: the platform's messaging service for customers and sellers

examples.en: I sent the photo through buyer-seller messaging so it stayed with the order.
examples.zh: 我通过「买卖双方站内消息」发了照片，这样照片就会和订单留在一起。

examples.en: The platform displayed the seller's reply in the buyer-seller messaging area.
examples.zh: 平台把卖家的回复显示在「买卖双方站内消息」区。

collocations: find a thread in buyer-seller messaging

words.enDefinition: messages previously exchanged in a conversation or account

examples.en: I checked the message history to see whether the seller had replied yesterday.
examples.zh: 我查看了「历史消息记录」，想知道卖家昨天有没有回复。

examples.en: The staff member could only see the message history for this order.
examples.zh: 工作人员只能看到这笔订单的「历史消息记录」。

collocations: a reply in the message history

words.enDefinition: a way to reach a support team, such as phone or chat

examples.en: The order page offered a different contact channel for purchases made through the marketplace.
examples.zh: 订单页面给出了另一种「联系渠道」，处理通过平台买的商品。

examples.en: I chose a contact channel that let me upload photos from my laptop.
examples.zh: 我选了一个能用笔记本电脑上传照片的「联系渠道」。

words.enDefinition: to ask for assistance related to an existing purchase

examples.en: I clicked the button to get help with an order from last week.
examples.zh: 我点了按钮，为「上周那笔订单找客服帮忙」。

examples.en: You can get help with an order from its page in the app.
examples.zh: 在这个应用里，你可以到订单页面「找客服处理订单问题」。

collocations: get help with an order online
get help with an order from a seller
click to get help with an order

words.enDefinition: an offer from support to look up a customer's purchase

examples.en: “Let me check your order,” she said after I spelled my surname.
examples.zh: 我把姓氏拼给她听后，她说「我帮你查一下订单」。

examples.en: The adviser said, “Let me check your order,” before asking when I bought it.
examples.zh: 客服说「我帮你查一下订单」，然后问我是什么时候买的。

collocations: “Let me check your order against the receipt”

words.enDefinition: the email address associated with a particular purchase

examples.en: The agent asked for my order email address before looking up the purchase.
examples.zh: 客服先问了我「下单时用的邮箱」，然后才查这笔交易。

examples.en: I had entered my school account as the order email address by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误把学校账号当成了「下单时用的邮箱」。

words.enDefinition: finding a purchase record by its details in a system

examples.en: The order lookup showed the desk and the chair as separate purchases.
examples.zh: 「订单查询」显示，书桌和椅子是分开买的。

examples.en: A store associate used order lookup to find the sale in their system.
examples.zh: 一名门店店员用「订单查询」在系统里找到了这笔交易。

collocations: an order lookup by email address

words.enDefinition: a statement explaining that you cannot locate your purchase record

examples.en: I can't find my order even though the confirmation email arrived yesterday.
examples.zh: 「我找不到自己的订单」，可我昨天已经收到确认邮件了。

examples.en: “I can't find my order,” I wrote after signing into both accounts.
examples.zh: 我登录过两个账户后写道「我找不到自己的订单」。

collocations: “I can't find my order in the app”
“I can't find my order in my account”

words.enDefinition: a shipped item whose size differs from the size ordered

examples.en: I chose “wrong size sent” and showed the label inside the shirt.
examples.zh: 我选了「尺码发错了」，给客服看了衬衫里面的标签。

examples.en: The chat window showed “wrong size sent” as one possible reason to contact support.
examples.zh: 聊天窗口把「尺码发错了」列为联系客户支持的一个原因。

collocations: report that the wrong size was sent

words.enDefinition: one product that should be present in a delivered package

examples.en: The clerk asked me to identify the item missing from the parcel.
examples.zh: 店员请我说一下「包裹里少的是哪件商品」。

examples.en: The seller compared the item missing from the parcel with the packing slip.
examples.zh: 卖家把「包裹里少的那件商品」和装箱单对照了一下。

collocations: report an item missing from the parcel
tell us which item is missing from the parcel
an item missing from the parcel when it arrived

words.enDefinition: a group of items sold together with some pieces absent

examples.en: I explained that I had received an incomplete set of cups as a gift.
examples.zh: 我说明收到的是一套送人的「缺件杯具」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the incomplete set still had its original insert.
examples.zh: 客服问那套「缺件套装」里还留着原来的夹页吗。

words.enDefinition: a number of items different from what was ordered

examples.en: I reported the wrong quantity after counting the notebooks in the two boxes.
examples.zh: 数过两个箱子里的笔记本后，我报告说「数量不对」。

examples.en: The seller admitted that the wrong quantity had been packed at the warehouse.
examples.zh: 卖家承认仓库装箱时「数量装错了」。

words.enDefinition: a shipment containing fewer units than were supposed to be sent

examples.en: The agent called it a short shipment after comparing the photos with the invoice.
examples.zh: 客服对照照片和发票后，说这是「发货数量不足」。

examples.en: The seller asked for a photo of the contents to review the short shipment.
examples.zh: 卖家要包裹内容物的照片，以便核查「发货数量不足」的情况。

words.expression: I received one instead of two
words.lemma: i received one instead of two
words.zhGloss: 说好的两件只收到一件
words.enDefinition: a statement explaining that only half the ordered units arrived
acceptedZhAnswers: 说好的两件只收到一件
acceptedEnVariants: I received one instead of two

examples.en: I received one instead of two, although both chargers appear on the receipt.
examples.zh: 「说好的两件我只收到一件」，收据上却列了两个充电器。

examples.en: “I received one instead of two,” I wrote when reporting the missing notebook.
examples.zh: 我上报少了一本笔记本时写道「说好的两件我只收到一件」。

collocations: say “I received one instead of two”
“I received one instead of two in the box”
“I received one instead of two in the first delivery”

words.expression: is the rest of the order coming separately
words.lemma: is the rest of the order coming separately
words.zhGloss: 剩下的商品会另外寄吗
words.enDefinition: a question about whether outstanding items will arrive in another shipment
acceptedZhAnswers: 剩下的商品会另外寄吗
acceptedEnVariants: is the rest of the order coming separately

examples.en: “Is the rest of the order coming separately?” I asked after opening the box.
examples.zh: 我打开箱子后问「剩下的商品会另外寄吗？」

examples.en: The student asked, “Is the rest of the order coming separately?” when contacting support.
examples.zh: 那名学生联系客户支持时问「剩下的商品会另外寄吗？」

collocations: ask “Is the rest of the order coming separately?”
“Is the rest of the order coming separately in a second box?”
“Is the rest of the order coming separately from these items?”

words.enDefinition: a product sent in place of what was ordered

examples.en: The seller explained why a substituted item had appeared in the order summary.
examples.zh: 卖家解释了订单总览为什么出现了一件「替代发货的商品」。

examples.en: I asked whether the substituted item had the same dimensions as the original.
examples.zh: 我问那件「替代发货的商品」和原来那件的尺寸是否相同。

words.enDefinition: advertised as new rather than used in a product listing

examples.en: The jacket was listed as new, but the cuffs were already worn.
examples.zh: 那件夹克「标为全新」，袖口却已经磨旧了。

examples.en: I sent a screenshot showing that the lamp had been listed as new.
examples.zh: 我发了张截图，显示那盏台灯曾「标为全新」。

collocations: listed as new on the website
something listed as new but opened

words.enDefinition: an order problem where the buyer has not received a product

examples.en: I selected “item not received” after checking whether my roommate had taken the parcel.
examples.zh: 我确认室友没代收包裹后，选了「未收到商品」。

examples.en: The store lists “item not received” separately from damage to an item.
examples.zh: 店家把「未收到商品」和商品损坏分开列出。

collocations: respond to an “item not received” report

words.enDefinition: a delivered parcel containing none of the items expected

examples.en: I showed the adviser the empty package with the label still attached.
examples.zh: 我把还贴着标签的「空包裹」给客服看了。

examples.en: The shop wanted a photo of the label on the empty package.
examples.zh: 店家想要一张「空包裹」上标签的照片。

collocations: a photo of an empty package

words.enDefinition: damage to the packaging immediately around the item inside a shipping carton

examples.en: I reported inner packaging damage after finding a torn sleeve around the glass.
examples.zh: 发现玻璃外面的护套破了后，我报告了「内包装损坏」。

examples.en: The support team asked for a photograph showing the inner packaging damage clearly.
examples.zh: 客服团队请我提供一张能清楚看出「内包装损坏」的照片。

words.enDefinition: the outer layer that encloses a product or its inner box

examples.en: The adviser asked for a photo of the outer packaging beside the broken jar.
examples.zh: 客服请我拍一张「外包装」和破罐子放在一起的照片。

examples.en: The outer packaging looked fine, but the bottle inside was cracked.
examples.zh: 「外包装」看着没问题，但里面的瓶子裂了。

collocations: a photo of the outer packaging

words.enDefinition: to save the box and wrapping instead of throwing them away

examples.en: The seller asked me to keep the packaging while they checked the photos.
examples.zh: 卖家让我先「保留包装」，他们要看一下照片。

examples.en: I decided to keep the packaging until the shop had looked at the damage.
examples.zh: 我决定「保留包装」，等店家看过损坏情况再说。

collocations: ask a customer to keep the packaging
keep the packaging until the case is reviewed

words.enDefinition: pictures showing what was broken, marked or otherwise damaged

examples.en: I uploaded photos of the damage and a picture of the address label.
examples.zh: 我上传了「受损照片」和一张地址标签的照片。

examples.en: The store said the photos of the damage were visible in the chat.
examples.zh: 店家说，他们能在聊天里看到「受损照片」。

words.enDefinition: a saved image showing what the product listing displayed

examples.en: My listing screenshot showed that the cable was included at the time.
examples.zh: 我的「商品页面截图」显示，那时电线是随商品附送的。

examples.en: I attached the listing screenshot so staff could compare it with the receipt.
examples.zh: 我附上「商品页面截图」，让工作人员和收据对照。

words.enDefinition: a purchase document issued to a different shopper

examples.en: I found someone else's invoice in the box and contacted the seller.
examples.zh: 我在箱子里发现了「别人的购物发票」，于是联系了卖家。

examples.en: The package contained someone else's invoice even though my name was on it.
examples.zh: 包裹上写的是我的名字，里面却是「别人的购物发票」。

collocations: find someone else's invoice in the parcel
a box containing someone else's invoice

words.enDefinition: a mistake while preparing or sending out an order

examples.en: The retailer confirmed there had been a fulfilment error with my first parcel.
examples.zh: 零售商确认，我的第一个包裹有「订单发货差错」。

examples.en: They described it as a fulfilment error after comparing the order and warehouse record.
examples.zh: 他们对照订单和仓库记录后，把它定为「订单发货差错」。

words.enDefinition: a mistake in what a warehouse or seller puts in a package

examples.en: The seller traced the extra mug to a packing error at the warehouse.
examples.zh: 卖家查到多出来的马克杯是仓库的「装箱差错」造成的。

examples.en: I thought it was a packing error because both boxes had my name.
examples.zh: 两个箱子都写着我的名字，所以我觉得是「装箱差错」。

words.zhGloss: 收件人写的是别的顾客
words.enDefinition: bearing a label with a different shopper as the recipient
acceptedZhAnswers: 收件人写的是别的顾客

examples.en: The box was addressed to another customer, although the receipt inside was mine.
examples.zh: 箱里的收据是我的，但「收件人写的是别的顾客」。

examples.en: I told the seller the parcel was addressed to another customer nearby.
examples.zh: 我告诉卖家，「收件人写的是附近的另一位顾客」。

collocations: a parcel addressed to another customer
a package mistakenly addressed to another customer
report a parcel addressed to another customer

words.expression: can you confirm what was shipped
words.lemma: can you confirm what was shipped
words.zhGloss: 能确认一下实际发了什么吗
words.enDefinition: a request to verify which products were sent
acceptedZhAnswers: 能确认一下实际发了什么吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you confirm what was shipped

examples.en: “Can you confirm what was shipped?” I asked after comparing the two labels.
examples.zh: 对照两张标签后，我问「能确认一下实际发了什么吗？」

examples.en: I sent the order number and wrote, “Can you confirm what was shipped?”
examples.zh: 我发了订单号，并写道「能确认一下实际发了什么吗？」

collocations: ask “Can you confirm what was shipped?”
“Can you confirm what was shipped on Monday?”
“Can you confirm what was shipped in the second parcel?”

words.enDefinition: a tracked request for help with a particular problem

examples.en: I opened a support ticket after the shop asked for more information.
examples.zh: 店家要求补充信息后，我创建了一个「客服工单」。

examples.en: The photos were attached to my support ticket by the next morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，我的「客服工单」里已经附上了照片。

words.enDefinition: the current stage of a request in a support system

examples.en: I checked the ticket status before contacting the shop a second time.
examples.zh: 第二次联系店家前，我先查了「工单状态」。

examples.en: The ticket status changed after the adviser added the photos to my case.
examples.zh: 客服把照片加到我的工单里后，「工单状态」变了。

words.enDefinition: a support request that is still active in the system

examples.en: I added the second photo to my open ticket for the damaged lamp.
examples.zh: 我把第二张照片加到了那盏损坏台灯的「尚未关闭的工单」里。

examples.en: The agent found an open ticket from when I called last week.
examples.zh: 客服找到了我上周打电话时创建的「尚未关闭的工单」。

collocations: an open ticket for the same issue

words.enDefinition: a status showing that support is waiting to hear from the customer

examples.en: The status said “awaiting customer response” because I hadn't attached a picture yet.
examples.zh: 状态显示「等待买家回复」，因为我还没附上照片。

examples.en: I checked the message after my case changed to “awaiting customer response” that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，工单变为「等待买家回复」，我便去查看了消息。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that no staff member has taken the request yet

examples.en: My ticket showed “awaiting agent assignment” when I checked the app after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后查看应用时，工单显示「等待分配客服」。

examples.en: The page still said “awaiting agent assignment” after I uploaded the photos.
examples.zh: 我上传照片后，页面仍显示「等待分配客服」。

words.enDefinition: a confirmation that a new support request has entered the system

examples.en: The page showed “ticket created” after I sent details about the missing item.
examples.zh: 我发送漏发商品的详情后，页面显示「工单已创建」。

examples.en: I saved the message that said “ticket created” because it included a reference.
examples.zh: 我保存了显示「工单已创建」的消息，因为里面有一个编号。

collocations: a ticket created after a chat

words.enDefinition: earlier contacts and requests recorded by a support team

examples.en: The agent looked through my support history before asking for the order number.
examples.zh: 客服先看了我的「客服联系记录」，然后才问订单号。

examples.en: I checked my support history to find the request about the desk leg.
examples.zh: 我查了「客服联系记录」，找那笔和桌腿有关的申请。

words.enDefinition: the staff member currently responsible for a support request

examples.en: I sent the new photo to the assigned agent through the case page.
examples.zh: 我通过工单页面把新照片发给了「指定处理客服」。

examples.en: The assigned agent introduced herself and said she had read my earlier messages.
examples.zh: 「指定处理客服」先报了自己的名字，说已经看过我之前的消息。

words.enDefinition: a short record added to a support request

examples.en: The case note said that the seller had already checked the warehouse record.
examples.zh: 「工单备注」写着卖家已经核对过仓库记录。

examples.en: The adviser read the case note before asking a follow-up question.
examples.zh: 客服先看了「工单备注」，然后问了我一个后续问题。

words.enDefinition: a note visible to staff rather than the customer

examples.en: The adviser said she had added an internal note about the extra parcel.
examples.zh: 客服说，她已经就多出的那个包裹加了一条「客服内部备注」。

examples.en: An internal note helped the second agent find the photos I had sent.
examples.zh: 一条「客服内部备注」让第二位客服找到了我发过的照片。

collocations: save an internal note to the case

words.enDefinition: a message confirming support has received a request

examples.en: I got a case acknowledgment moments after sending the form to customer support.
examples.zh: 给客户支持发送表单后，我很快就收到了「工单受理确认」。

examples.en: The case acknowledgment included a link to the page with my latest messages.
examples.zh: 「工单受理确认」里有一个链接，可以打开显示我最近消息的页面。

collocations: an email with a case acknowledgment

words.enDefinition: new information provided about the progress of a support request

examples.en: The case update said the adviser was still checking the parcel records.
examples.zh: 「工单进展通知」说，客服还在核对包裹记录。

examples.en: I got a case update while waiting for the seller to send a photo.
examples.zh: 我等卖家发照片时，收到了一条「工单进展通知」。

words.enDefinition: to check again about a support request already in the system

examples.en: I used the same email address to follow up on a ticket from Monday.
examples.zh: 我用同一个邮箱「跟进周一的一笔工单」。

examples.en: The help page showed me how to follow up on a ticket online.
examples.zh: 帮助页面告诉我如何在网上「跟进一笔工单」。

collocations: follow up on a ticket by email
call to follow up on a ticket
follow up on a ticket from last week

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether there is any new information about your request

examples.en: “Any update on my case?” I wrote after the shop missed its promised reply.
examples.zh: 店家说好的回复时间过了，我写道「我的工单有进展吗？」

examples.en: I reopened the chat that afternoon and typed, “Any update on my case?”
examples.zh: 那天下午我重新打开聊天框，打字问「我的工单有进展吗？」

collocations: “Is there any update on my case?”
“Any update on my case since yesterday?”

words.enDefinition: to find the record of my existing support request

examples.en: Could you look up my case using the reference in this email?
examples.zh: 你能用这封邮件里的编号「查一下我的工单」吗？

examples.en: I asked the adviser to look up my case from the previous week.
examples.zh: 我请客服「查一下我上周的工单」。

collocations: ask someone to look up my case
use this reference to look up my case
can you look up my case

words.enDefinition: to transfer an existing support request from one handler to another

examples.en: The shop had to reassign the case after the first adviser went off shift.
examples.zh: 第一位客服下班后，商家不得不「把工单转给另一位客服处理」。

examples.en: They offered to reassign the case to someone who handled online purchases.
examples.zh: 他们提出，可以「把工单转给网购客服处理」。

collocations: reassign the case to another adviser
ask staff to reassign the case

words.enDefinition: a second look at an issue or decision by a supervisor

examples.en: I asked for a supervisor review after receiving two different answers about the package.
examples.zh: 包裹的事得到两种不同答复后，我申请了「主管复核」。

examples.en: The page showed that the request had moved to supervisor review that morning.
examples.zh: 页面显示，那天上午申请已转入「主管复核」。

collocations: send a case for supervisor review

words.enDefinition: a request to send an issue to someone with greater authority

examples.en: The adviser added my emails to the escalation request for the order that never arrived.
examples.zh: 客服把我的邮件加进了这笔一直没送到的订单的「升级处理申请」。

examples.en: I asked when the escalation request would reach the team handling seller disputes.
examples.zh: 我问「升级处理申请」什么时候会到负责卖家纠纷的团队。

words.enDefinition: a group that handles problems referred by initial support staff

examples.en: The escalation team asked the seller why the label showed the wrong model.
examples.zh: 「升级工单处理团队」问卖家为什么标签上的型号不对。

examples.en: An adviser from the escalation team contacted me after my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 下午的课结束后，「升级工单处理团队」的一名客服联系了我。

collocations: refer a case to the escalation team
a response from the escalation team

words.enDefinition: being examined without a result or decision yet

examples.en: The shop said my order problem was still under investigation on Friday.
examples.zh: 店家说，截至周五，我的订单问题「仍在调查中」。

examples.en: I got a message saying the missing parcel was still under investigation.
examples.zh: 我收到消息，说包裹丢失的情况「仍在调查中」。

collocations: confirm something is still under investigation

words.enDefinition: a response saying staff are finding out what happened

examples.en: The reply said, “We're looking into it,” after I showed the two receipts.
examples.zh: 我出示两张收据后，对方回复「我们正在查」。

examples.en: The agent said, “We're looking into it,” and asked me to stay in the chat.
examples.zh: 客服说「我们正在查」，并请我先别离开聊天窗口。

collocations: “We're looking into it with the warehouse”

words.enDefinition: a response confirming that staff asked the warehouse about the matter

examples.en: The seller wrote, “We've checked with the warehouse,” before confirming what was packed.
examples.zh: 卖家写道「我们已和仓库核实」，然后确认了装箱内容。

examples.en: “We've checked with the warehouse,” the agent said before describing the other box.
examples.zh: 在说明另一个箱子的情况前，客服说「我们已和仓库核实」。

collocations: “We've checked with the warehouse about this item”
“We've checked with the warehouse and will email you”

words.enDefinition: a way to tell someone images are included with your message

examples.en: I've attached the photos so you can see both labels side by side.
examples.zh: 「我把照片附上了」，你可以对照看两张标签。

examples.en: “I've attached the photos,” I wrote below the description of the broken clasp.
examples.zh: 我在描述坏掉的搭扣后写道「我把照片附上了」。

collocations: “I've attached the photos to this message”

words.enDefinition: a delivery sent to replace or supply an affected order item

examples.en: The seller confirmed the replacement shipment would contain just the missing table legs.
examples.zh: 卖家确认，「补发的货件」里只有漏发的桌腿。

examples.en: I checked whether the replacement shipment could go to the campus mail desk.
examples.zh: 我确认了「补发的货件」能不能寄到学校的邮件收发台。

collocations: a replacement shipment for the missing items

words.enDefinition: to send the parcel again after an earlier sending problem

examples.en: The retailer offered to reship the parcel after finding its address label was unreadable.
examples.zh: 零售商发现地址标签无法辨认后，提出「重新寄出包裹」。

examples.en: The agent asked whether to reship the parcel to my term-time address.
examples.zh: 客服问要不要把「包裹重新寄」到我学期内住的地址。

collocations: reship the parcel to a new address

words.enDefinition: to post an item that did not arrive with the rest

examples.en: I asked the shop to resend the missing item to the same address.
examples.zh: 我请店家把「漏寄的商品补发」到同一个地址。

examples.en: The seller offered to resend the missing item after checking the packing slip.
examples.zh: 卖家核对装箱单后，提出「补发漏寄的商品」。

collocations: offer to resend the missing item
agree to resend the missing item

words.enDefinition: a code used to follow a replacement parcel in transit

examples.en: The replacement tracking number arrived in a separate email from the retailer.
examples.zh: 零售商另发了一封邮件，给了「补发包裹的物流单号」。

examples.en: I copied the replacement tracking number from the support message into my notes.
examples.zh: 我把客服消息里的「补发包裹的物流单号」复制到了笔记里。

words.enDefinition: a message confirming that the seller has arranged a replacement shipment

examples.en: The replacement confirmation listed the chair cushion that hadn't arrived in the box.
examples.zh: 「补发确认通知」上列出了箱子里没收到的坐垫。

examples.en: I reread the replacement confirmation to check which address the retailer had used.
examples.zh: 我重新看了「补发确认通知」，核对零售商用的是哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the replacement has been sent

examples.en: The case page displayed “replacement dispatched” after the store had corrected the address.
examples.zh: 店家改正地址后，工单页面显示「补发商品已寄出」。

examples.en: I saw “replacement dispatched” when I checked the app after class on Thursday.
examples.zh: 周四下课后我查看应用，看到了「补发商品已寄出」。

words.enDefinition: to verify that a sent item reached its recipient

examples.en: The seller asked me to confirm that it arrived before closing the case.
examples.zh: 卖家让我先「确认东西收到了」，然后再关闭工单。

examples.en: I'll confirm that it arrived once I can get to the mailroom.
examples.zh: 我能去收发室的时候再「确认东西收到了」。

collocations: reply to confirm that it arrived
ask someone to confirm that it arrived
check the label and confirm that it arrived

words.enDefinition: a marketplace program that helps with qualifying purchase problems

examples.en: I checked whether buyer protection applied to the order I placed online.
examples.zh: 我查了「买家保障」是否适用我在网上下的那笔订单。

examples.en: The marketplace described buyer protection on a page linked from the order.
examples.zh: 电商平台在订单链接到的页面上介绍了「买家保障」。

words.enDefinition: a request for help under a purchase protection program

examples.en: My buyer protection claim included photos showing the item I actually received.
examples.zh: 我的「买家保障申请」里附了实际收到的商品照片。

examples.en: The marketplace assigned a reference to my buyer protection claim that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，电商平台给我的「买家保障申请」分配了一个编号。

collocations: a decision on a buyer protection claim

words.enDefinition: a purchase that meets the requirements of a particular program

examples.en: I asked whether the jacket counted as an eligible purchase under their program.
examples.zh: 我问这件夹克在他们的计划下算不算「符合保障条件的订单」。

examples.en: The notice didn't say whether a guest order was an eligible purchase.
examples.zh: 通知没有说访客下单算不算「符合保障条件的订单」。

collocations: check whether it is an eligible purchase

words.enDefinition: a platform area for managing disputes and claims

examples.en: I opened the resolution center to see the seller's reply to my claim.
examples.zh: 我打开「纠纷处理中心」，查看卖家对我申请的回复。

examples.en: The notice linked to the resolution center rather than the general help page.
examples.zh: 通知链接到的是「纠纷处理中心」，不是普通帮助页面。

collocations: a message in the resolution center

words.enDefinition: to begin a formal process for addressing a disputed purchase

examples.en: The platform showed me where to open a dispute about the missing parcel.
examples.zh: 平台给我看了在哪里针对丢失的包裹「发起纠纷申请」。

examples.en: I asked what information the site needed to open a dispute about this purchase.
examples.zh: 我问，要针对这次购物「发起纠纷申请」，网站需要哪些信息。

collocations: open a dispute with the seller
open a dispute through the platform

words.enDefinition: the category or explanation given for challenging a purchase

examples.en: I changed the dispute reason after discovering the invoice listed the wrong model.
examples.zh: 我发现凭据上的型号不对之后，更改了「发起纠纷的原因」。

examples.en: The form displayed my dispute reason above the description I had typed.
examples.zh: 表单把「发起纠纷的原因」显示在我输入的说明上面。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the process cannot continue until the seller responds

examples.en: The case still said “waiting on the seller” when I checked after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后查看时，工单仍然显示「等待卖家答复」。

examples.en: I asked what “waiting on the seller” meant for the order page.
examples.zh: 我问订单页面上的「等待卖家答复」是在说什么。

collocations: a case marked “waiting on the seller”

words.enDefinition: to send a reply on or before a stated deadline

examples.en: The message asked me to respond by Friday if I had more photos.
examples.zh: 消息说，如果我还有照片，要「最晚周五回复」。

examples.en: I emailed the seller because the case asked me to respond by noon.
examples.zh: 工单要求我「最晚中午回复」，所以我给卖家发了邮件。

collocations: ask the seller to respond by Friday

words.enDefinition: showing no reply was received by the expected time

examples.en: The case page showed “response overdue” beside the seller's last message.
examples.zh: 工单页面在卖家的最后一条消息旁显示「回复已超期」。

examples.en: I saw “response overdue” when checking whether the marketplace had heard from the seller.
examples.zh: 我在查看平台有没有收到卖家消息时，看到了「回复已超期」。

collocations: a case with a response overdue

words.enDefinition: a system ending a case without a person closing it

examples.en: The automated message warned of automatic case closure if nobody replied to it.
examples.zh: 自动消息提示，如果没人回复，就会「工单自动关闭」。

examples.en: I asked whether automatic case closure affected my ability to see the chat.
examples.zh: 我问「工单自动关闭」后，我还能不能查看聊天内容。

collocations: notify users of automatic case closure
check the reason for automatic case closure

words.expression: ask the marketplace to step in
words.lemma: ask the marketplace to step in
words.enDefinition: to request intervention from the company running the marketplace
acceptedEnVariants: ask the marketplace to step in

examples.en: I could ask the marketplace to step in from the same order page.
examples.zh: 我能在同一个订单页面上「请电商平台介入」。

examples.en: I sent one final message before deciding whether to ask the marketplace to step in.
examples.zh: 我最后又发了一条消息，然后才决定要不要「请电商平台介入」。

collocations: choose to ask the marketplace to step in
ask the marketplace to step in on a case
decide whether to ask the marketplace to step in

words.enDefinition: assistance from a marketplace in trying to resolve a dispute between users

examples.en: The seller agreed to platform mediation after we both uploaded our photos.
examples.zh: 我们双方上传照片后，卖家同意「平台调解」。

examples.en: I read about platform mediation while waiting for the seller to reply.
examples.zh: 我等卖家回复时，读了「平台调解」的介绍。

collocations: a case referred to platform mediation

words.enDefinition: documents or images used to establish what happened in a case

examples.en: The adviser grouped my photos and receipt together as case evidence.
examples.zh: 客服把我的照片和收据归在一起，作为「工单材料」。

examples.en: I could see all the case evidence after signing back into the marketplace.
examples.zh: 我重新登录电商平台后，可以看到所有「工单材料」。

words.enDefinition: to examine information supporting the different accounts of a dispute

examples.en: The platform said someone would review the evidence before issuing a decision.
examples.zh: 平台说会有人先「查阅证据材料」，然后作出决定。

examples.en: I asked if the supervisor could review the evidence from both messages.
examples.zh: 我问主管能不能「查阅两条消息里的证据材料」。

collocations: review the evidence from both sides
ask staff to review the evidence
take time to review the evidence

words.enDefinition: a request from support for an image of the issue

examples.en: The seller wrote, “We need a photo,” after asking whether the box was intact.
examples.zh: 卖家问箱子完不完整，接着写道「我们需要一张照片」。

examples.en: “We need a photo,” the adviser said, pointing to the worn label.
examples.zh: 客服指着磨损的标签说「我们需要一张照片」。

collocations: “We need a photo of the serial number”
“We need a photo of the whole package”

words.enDefinition: a question asking what result someone wants from a complaint

examples.en: The platform asked, “What is your preferred outcome?” before opening the text box.
examples.zh: 文字框打开前，平台问「你希望怎么解决？」

examples.en: The supervisor read my email and then asked, “What is your preferred outcome?”
examples.zh: 主管读了我的邮件，然后问「你希望怎么解决？」

collocations: “What is your preferred outcome in this situation?”
“What is your preferred outcome for this order?”

words.enDefinition: a suggested way to settle the problem under discussion

examples.en: The seller's proposed resolution was to send the compatible cable the next day.
examples.zh: 卖家的「建议的解决方案」是第二天寄一根兼容的电线。

examples.en: I asked for the proposed resolution in writing before replying to the case.
examples.zh: 回复工单前，我要了一份书面的「建议的解决方案」。

words.enDefinition: an outcome that addresses the problem well enough to be accepted

examples.en: The customer did not consider a generic apology a satisfactory resolution.
examples.zh: 顾客觉得一句笼统的道歉算不上「令人满意的解决结果」。

examples.en: I reached a satisfactory resolution once the missing parts arrived at reception.
examples.zh: 缺少的零件送到前台后，我得到了「令人满意的解决结果」。

words.enDefinition: the result recorded after a disputed matter has been considered

examples.en: I read the dispute outcome after receiving an email from the marketplace.
examples.zh: 我收到电商平台的邮件后，查看了「纠纷处理结果」。

examples.en: The dispute outcome explained which photos were relevant to the decision.
examples.zh: 「纠纷处理结果」说明了哪些照片和处理决定有关。

collocations: notify someone of the dispute outcome

words.enDefinition: a decision accepting the buyer's position in a dispute

examples.en: The marketplace issued a decision in the buyer's favor after reviewing both messages.
examples.zh: 电商平台查看双方消息后，作出了「支持买家的处理决定」。

examples.en: The platform said its decision in the buyer's favor was now on the case page.
examples.zh: 平台说，「支持买家的处理决定」现在已经显示在工单页面上。

collocations: issue a decision in the buyer's favor
record a decision in the buyer's favor
receive notice of a decision in the buyer's favor

words.enDefinition: not meeting the requirements to receive help under a buyer program

examples.en: The app said the purchase was not eligible for buyer protection but gave no explanation.
examples.zh: 应用说这笔交易「不符合买家保障条件」，但没说明原因。

examples.en: I asked why the item was marked not eligible for buyer protection.
examples.zh: 我问为什么这件商品被标成「不符合买家保障条件」。

collocations: marked not eligible for buyer protection
an order not eligible for buyer protection
a purchase listed as not eligible for buyer protection

words.enDefinition: a request to reconsider a support or dispute decision

examples.en: I filed a case appeal after finding the original photo on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上找到原始照片后，提交了「工单复核申请」。

examples.en: The help page explained how a case appeal differed from adding a comment.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了「工单复核申请」和添加留言有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: an exception an organization agrees to for one particular situation

examples.en: The supervisor said the extra delivery would be a one-time exception for my order.
examples.zh: 主管说，这笔订单追加一次配送是「仅此一次的例外」。

examples.en: The adviser offered a one-time exception after checking the earlier messages.
examples.zh: 客服翻看之前的消息后，提出可以作「仅此一次的例外」处理。

words.enDefinition: to ask someone to confirm spoken information in writing

examples.en: I went back to ask for written confirmation of the dispatch address.
examples.zh: 我回去「索取了书面确认」，想核实寄送地址。

examples.en: The buyer chose to ask for written confirmation after a long phone call.
examples.zh: 打了很久的电话后，买家决定「索取书面确认」。

collocations: ask for written confirmation by email
ask for written confirmation of the arrangement
call and ask for written confirmation

words.enDefinition: the result of a decision provided in a written message

examples.en: I received a written outcome although the case had been discussed by phone.
examples.zh: 这笔工单是电话沟通的，我也收到了「书面处理结果」。

examples.en: I checked the written outcome before explaining the agreement to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先查看「书面处理结果」，然后向室友解释了双方约好的事。

words.enDefinition: a label showing that a problem has been dealt with

examples.en: I selected “issue resolved” after the correct lamp finally arrived on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二终于收到正确的台灯后，我选了「问题已解决」。

examples.en: The case displayed “issue resolved” below the latest note from support.
examples.zh: 工单在客服最新备注下方显示「问题已解决」。

words.enDefinition: closed without a result that addresses the problem

examples.en: My case was closed with no resolution after the seller stopped answering messages.
examples.zh: 卖家不再回复消息后，我的工单「未解决就关闭了」。

examples.en: The page said “closed with no resolution,” although I had sent the requested photo.
examples.zh: 虽然我已经发了要求的照片，页面仍显示「未解决就关闭了」。

collocations: a dispute closed with no resolution

words.enDefinition: a public body responsible for protecting consumers in the marketplace

examples.en: The consumer protection agency had information on how it handles shopping complaints.
examples.zh: 「消费者保护机构」提供了他们如何处理购物投诉的说明。

examples.en: I found the consumer protection agency listed separately from the retailer's own hotline.
examples.zh: 我发现名单把「消费者保护机构」和零售商自己的热线分开列出。

collocations: guidance from a consumer protection agency

words.enDefinition: a form for recording and submitting a consumer's complaint

examples.en: The consumer complaint form asked me to name the business I had contacted.
examples.zh: 「消费者投诉表」要求我填写联系过的商家名称。

examples.en: I saved the consumer complaint form while I looked for the original order email.
examples.zh: 我保存了「消费者投诉表」，好先去找原来的订单邮件。

words.enDefinition: a service providing information or guidance to people about purchases

examples.en: I asked the consumer advice service what the wording on the letter meant.
examples.zh: 我向「消费者咨询服务」询问信里的说法是什么意思。

examples.en: The website listed a consumer advice service for general questions about purchases.
examples.zh: 网站列出了可以回答一般购物问题的「消费者咨询服务」。

collocations: speak to a consumer advice service

words.expression: can you see my previous messages
words.lemma: can you see my previous messages
words.zhGloss: 你能看到我之前的消息吗
words.enDefinition: a question checking whether another adviser can read earlier messages
acceptedZhAnswers: 你能看到我之前的消息吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you see my previous messages

examples.en: “Can you see my previous messages?” I asked when another adviser joined the chat.
examples.zh: 另一位客服接入聊天时，我问「你能看到我之前的消息吗？」

examples.en: I typed, “Can you see my previous messages?” before explaining the problem again.
examples.zh: 在重新说明问题之前，我打字问「你能看到我之前的消息吗？」

collocations: ask “Can you see my previous messages?”
“Can you see my previous messages about this order?”
“Can you see my previous messages in this chat?”

words.expression: this is my second time contacting you
words.lemma: this is my second time contacting you
words.zhGloss: 这是我第二次联系你们
words.enDefinition: a way to tell support this is a repeat contact
acceptedZhAnswers: 这是我第二次联系你们
acceptedEnVariants: this is my second time contacting you

examples.en: This is my second time contacting you about the package with the incorrect label.
examples.zh: 关于标签不对的包裹，「这是我第二次联系你们」。

examples.en: “This is my second time contacting you,” I wrote below the reference number.
examples.zh: 我在编号下面写道「这是我第二次联系你们」。

collocations: say “This is my second time contacting you”
“This is my second time contacting you about this order”
“This is my second time contacting you this week”

words.expression: transfer me to the right department
words.lemma: transfer me to the right department
words.enDefinition: to route my call to the team that handles the issue
acceptedEnVariants: transfer me to the right department

examples.en: Could you transfer me to the right department for purchases from your app?
examples.zh: 应用里购买的商品，你能「把我转给负责的部门」吗？

examples.en: I asked her to transfer me to the right department instead of ending the call.
examples.zh: 我请她「把我转给负责的部门」，别把电话挂了。

collocations: could you transfer me to the right department
ask someone to transfer me to the right department
please transfer me to the right department

words.enDefinition: a statement indicating the current listing differs from an earlier version

examples.en: The product page has changed since I placed my order last Monday.
examples.zh: 自从上周一下单后，「商品页面改过了」。

examples.en: I told the seller, “The product page has changed,” and attached my screenshot.
examples.zh: 我告诉卖家「商品页面改过了」，还附上了我的截图。

collocations: “The product page has changed since I ordered”

words.expression: how long will the review take
words.lemma: how long will the review take
words.enDefinition: a question about the time needed to examine a case
acceptedEnVariants: how long will the review take

examples.en: “How long will the review take?” I asked after sending the photo of the label.
examples.zh: 我发完标签照片后问「审核要多久？」

examples.en: The customer wrote, “How long will the review take?” after the complaint was assigned.
examples.zh: 投诉分配给客服后，顾客写道「审核要多久？」

collocations: ask “How long will the review take?”
“How long will the review take from here?”
“How long will the review take once you have the photos?”

words.expression: we have all the information we need
words.lemma: we have all the information we need
words.zhGloss: 我们需要的资料都齐了
words.enDefinition: a confirmation that staff have enough information to continue
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们需要的资料都齐了
acceptedEnVariants: we have all the information we need

examples.en: The adviser replied, “We have all the information we need,” and ended the chat.
examples.zh: 客服回复「我们需要的资料都齐了」，然后结束了聊天。

examples.en: “We have all the information we need,” the agent said after I confirmed the address.
examples.zh: 我确认完地址后，客服说「我们需要的资料都齐了」。

collocations: say “We have all the information we need”
“We have all the information we need for now”
“We have all the information we need to review it”

words.expression: we'll contact you once we hear back
words.lemma: we'll contact you once we hear back
words.zhGloss: 收到回复后我们会联系你
words.enDefinition: a promise to get in touch after another party replies
acceptedZhAnswers: 收到回复后我们会联系你
acceptedEnVariants: we'll contact you once we hear back

examples.en: “We'll contact you once we hear back,” the adviser said after messaging the seller.
examples.zh: 给卖家发完消息后，客服说「收到回复后我们会联系你」。

examples.en: The store asked its warehouse and wrote, “We'll contact you once we hear back.”
examples.zh: 店铺询问了仓库，然后写道「收到回复后我们会联系你」。

collocations: say “We'll contact you once we hear back”
“We'll contact you once we hear back from the seller”
“We'll contact you once we hear back from our warehouse”

words.expression: only the outer box was damaged
words.lemma: only the outer box was damaged
words.enDefinition: a report that the box was damaged but its contents were intact
acceptedEnVariants: only the outer box was damaged

examples.en: Only the outer box was damaged, so I reported that the lamp inside was fine.
examples.zh: 「只有外箱受损」，所以我报告说里面的台灯完好无损。

examples.en: “Only the outer box was damaged,” I wrote after checking each bowl in the set.
examples.zh: 我检查完套装里的每个碗后写道「只有外箱受损」。

collocations: say “Only the outer box was damaged”
“Only the outer box was damaged in transit”
“Only the outer box was damaged as far as I can tell”

words.enDefinition: an update stating that the seller verified part of the case

examples.en: The seller has confirmed that the spare screw should have been included.
examples.zh: 「卖家已经确认」，本该附上备用螺丝。

examples.en: Support wrote that the seller has confirmed which item was in the second parcel.
examples.zh: 客服写道，「卖家已经确认」第二个包裹里是哪件商品。

collocations: the seller has confirmed the details
the seller has confirmed the address
the seller has confirmed what was sent
